title: Lab results ingestion: retry counting that never dead-letters
name: Lab results DLQ

questions.prompt: The lab-results consumer has been pegged at 100% CPU since this morning, and clinicians report potassium and troponin results arriving hours late. The logs show the same result for one MRN failing with UnknownPatientError thousands of times (a patient whose registration was entered at the wrong site). The dead-letter queue is empty, even though malformed messages do still show up there. Fix the results consumer so the tests pass.
